channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: Budget 2026: Khelo India Mission proposed as sports allocation rises by 18 percent
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman outlined a comprehensive plan covering talent pathways, sports science, infrastructure and workforce development.

item.title: New Mexico Open: Krishna Jayasankar rewrites Indoor shot put national record
item.description: She clinched the women's shot put title with a new personal best of 16.63m.

item.title: Thailand Masters 2026: Devika Sihag crowned champion in women's singles
item.description: Devika also ended India's four-year wait for a Super300+ title in the women's singles category on foreign soil.

item.title: They laughed at my father's dream, now I coach India | By Joshuah Vaz
item.description: The national women’s futsal coach outlines his journey from player to elite instructor and highlights structural gaps in the women’s game.

item.title: Explainer | What the Union Budget 2026–27 means for Indian sport?
item.description: Sports allocation rises to ₹4,479.88 crore, with Khelo India emerging as the centrepiece of India’s elite development strategy.

item.title: WPL: Delhi Capitals enter Eliminator with five-wicket win over UP Warriorz
item.description: A composed chase led by Laura Wolvaardt and Jemimah Rodrigues sealed Delhi’s playoff spot and ended Mumbai Indians’ title defence.

item.title: How Stupa Sports is helping federations adapt data-driven growth
item.description: Co-founded by Megha Gambhir and Deepak Malik, Stupa Sports is changing how federations and leagues digitise their operations.

item.title: PWL 2026: Haryana Thunders crowned champions after edge-of-the-seat final
item.description: Haryana clinched the thrilling tie 5-4 in the topsy-turvy final against Delhi Dangal warriors.

item.title: Anahat Singh clinches her maiden PSA Bronze title at Squash on Fire Open
item.description: The teenager defeated world no. 10 Georgina Kennedy of England in straight games to become champion.

item.title: Tata Steel Chess Wijk aan Zee: Gukesh draws with Vincent Keymer to finish 9th
item.description: A disappointing end for the Indian campaign, as none of the four Indians could make it to the top 8.
